historical_exposure: The original generator's authorship is unrecorded; its source was read in full during this review and the product implementation was not consulted. The generator was edited here only to add the identity check, the locked-environment header and review carry-through.
independence_basis: Only the Python standard library is used; no estimator, simulator or identification routine is imported. Truth is the structural mean with noise integrated out. The cancellation identity is a second derivation of the delta from the lag weights and saturation alone.
limitations: Finite-population conditional truth (four retained groups, retained pre-period histories); not a predictive distribution or superpopulation contrast. random.Random stream stability across interpreters is assumed (CSV is byte-exact; JSON truth has a 1e-13 tolerance). The experiment_reference and acceptance records are not covered by this review. No calibration.
redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
scope: One seeded realization of the declared DGP; six retained artifacts regenerated byte-exact (JSON truth at 1e-13) and the cancellation identity verified for both variants over all periods.
